Trigger.Name: WHEN-VALIDATE-RECORD
Trigger.TriggerText:
if :system.block_status in ( 'QUERY')
then
 return;
end if;
--
if :addresses.addr_1 is null then
 message ('Err: First line of address must be entered');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
end if;
--
if :addresses.city is null then
 message ('Err: City must be entered');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
end if;
--
IF NVL(:INT_FLAG,'N') = 'N' THEN
if :addresses.state_code is null then
 message ('Err: State code must be entered');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
else
begin
 select 'x' into :global.x
 from master_codes
 where code_type = 'STATE'
 and code = :addresses.state_code
 and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate+1);
exception
 when no_data_found then
 message ('Err: Invalid State Code ');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 when others then handle_error;
end;

end if;
end if;
--
if :addresses.zip is null then
 message ('Err: Zip code must be entered');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
end if;
--
if :addresses.country is null then
 message ('Err: Country must be entered');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
end if;
--

Trigger.Name: KEY-COMMIT
Trigger.TriggerText:
begin
 if :system.block_status = 'CHANGED'
 then
 copy (to_char(:addresses.address_id) , name_in ('global.addr_field'));
 end if;
 --GO_ITEM(name_in('global.next_field'));
 GO_BLOCK('CHAPTERS');
 GO_ITEM('CHAPTERS.ISBT_START_DATE');
end;

 WHERE chapter_id = :chapters.chapter_id

Trigger.Name: WHEN-VALIDATE-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
Declare
 vchapter number;
Begin

if IS_TIMEZONE_ENABLED then
 if :chapters.time_zone is not null then
 select count(*) into vchapter 
 from master_codes
 where upper(code_type) = 'TZONE'
 and code_desc=:chapters.time_zone
 and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate+1);
 
 if vchapter=0 then
 show_error('7200');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 end if; 
 else
 :chapters.time_zone := ' ';
end if; 
 Exception
 when others then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 
End;

Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
BEGIN
 IF :chapters.validate_yy_value IS NOT NULL THEN
 IF :system.cursor_value not between 0 and 999 THEN
 show_error('1704');
 check_package_failure;
 END IF;
 IF :chapters.validate_yy_value < 0 
 AND :chapters.validate_yy_value != -1 THEN
 show_error('9716');
 check_package_failure;
 ELSIF :chapters.validate_yy_value > 31 THEN
 show_error('9708');
 check_package_failure;
 END IF;
 END IF;
EXCEPTION
 WHEN value_error THEN
 Raise Form_Trigger_Failure; 
 WHEN others THEN
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure; 
END;

Item.Name: EFF_DATE
Item.Hint: Enter effective date in DD-MON-YYYY format.

Trigger.Name: WHEN-VALIDATE-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
Declare
v_local_time date;
v_local_time1 date;
begin
 
if :chapters.eff_date is not null then
 if IS_TIMEZONE_ENABLED then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,sysdate,v_local_time);
 v_local_time1:= v_local_time;
 else
 v_local_time1:=sysdate;
 end if;
end if;
if :chapters.eff_date is null then
 show_error ('5002');
 check_package_failure;
end if;
--
-- Check that effective date is >= today
--
if trunc(:chapters.eff_date) < trunc(v_local_time1)
then
 show_error ('5003');
 check_package_failure;
end if;
exception
 when VALUE_ERROR
 then
 raise form_trigger_failure;
end;
